text:
QUOTE: "The deck list is checked only at execution" — more exactly: "The deny list is checked only at execution, so it still applies after anything has been approved." Also: "deny is the last gate."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says deny is enforced in ServerManager::execute, but it also says approval uses the allow-list, a callback, and other pre-checks, and it never concludes that deny is the only blocking list or that execute consults nothing else.
